PR (cited in the notes as #22264): fix: Race condition occurs during initial sharding [closed; labels ready-for-review, for-release-blog-3-0]
When an app informer runs, appcontroller has not start initialize the shard yet. This causes all the application was mistakenly assigned to the app controler that owns shard 0 (in k8s deployment, it will be application-controller-0) in the very beginning.

Once all the shard-cluster allocations are built up, application-controller-0 will be confused as some of the application it initially owned are no longer belonged to itself.

This race condition cause…

warning and application-controller-0 stop syncing any application.

This PR is to move the shard initialization before the appInformer go routing starts to avoid such race condition occurs.
